turns.text: Hey Lloyd, quick check on RSSC.org. Did any contact form submissions come through this morning?
Yes, I saw one submission come in from Aileen Tran earlier today.
Great, thanks for catching that. Also, is the weather looking good for the picnic this weekend?
The forecast says sunny with highs around 75°F, so it looks perfect.
Awesome. I also need to order some new HDMI cables for the office setup.
I can help you find some options. Do you have a specific length in mind?
10 feet should be enough. Just send me the links when you can.
Will do. I'll have those ready for you shortly.
